paper.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

result.summary: 本文提出 Vision Transformer（ViT），将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像分类，把图像切分为固定大小的图像块并作为序列输入 [S1.p3]。作者发现，在中小规模数据集（如 ImageNet）上训练时，ViT 的精度略低于同规模 ResNet [S1.p4]；但在大规模数据（14M–300M 图像）上预训练后，ViT 在多个图像识别基准上接近或超过当时的最优卷积网络，且预训练所需计算资源更少 [S1.p5][S4.SS2.p2]。作者认为，这一简单且可扩展的策略在结合大规模预训练时表现良好，使 ViT 在多个图像分类数据集上达到或超过当时的最优水平 [S5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中，卷积架构仍占主导，而将自注意力用于图像的工作要么与卷积网络结合，要么保留卷积网络整体结构 [S1.p2]。作者受 Transformer 在 NLP 中成功扩展的启发，尝试以尽可能少的修改，将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
Inspired by NLP successes, multiple works try combining CNN-like architectures with self-attention, some replacing the convolutions entirely.
Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.

method.text: 方法上，作者将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1]。模型沿用 BERT 的做法，在序列前加入一个可学习的分类 token，其编码器输出状态作为图像表示 [S3.SS1.p2]。作者指出，ViT 比 CNN 具有更少的图像特定归纳偏置，只有 MLP 层是局部且平移等变的，自注意力层是全局的 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
We note that Vision Transformer has much less image-specific inductive bias than CNNs.
In ViT, only MLP layers are local and translationally equivariant, while the self-attention layers are global.

experiments.text: 实验使用 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）进行预训练 [S4.SS1.p1]。迁移评估包括 ImageNet 原始验证标签与 ReaL 标签、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102，以及包含 19 个任务、每任务 1000 个训练样本的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型规模与输入块大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
its superset ImageNet-21k with 21k classes and 14M images, and JFT with 18k classes and 303M high-resolution images.

We transfer the models trained on these dataset to several benchmark tasks: ImageNet on the original validation labels and the cleaned-up ReaL labels, CIFAR-10/100, Oxford-IIIT Pets, and Oxford Flowers-102.
We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
VTAB evaluates low-data transfer to diverse tasks, using 1 000 training examples per task.
We base ViT configurations on those used for BERT, as summarized in Table 1.
The “Base” and “Large” models are directly adopted from BERT and we add the larger “Huge” model.

findings.text: 在中小规模数据集（如 ImageNet）上无强正则化训练时，ViT 的精度比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点 [S1.p4]。但在大规模数据上预训练后，较小的 ViT-L/16 在 JFT-300M 上预训练后在所有任务上超过同样在该数据集上预训练的 BiT-L，且训练所需计算资源显著更少 [S4.SS2.p2]。更大的 ViT-H/14 进一步提升性能，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 套件等更具挑战性的数据集上 [S4.SS2.p2]。最佳模型在 ImageNet 上达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 上 90.72%、CIFAR-100 上 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务套件上 77.63% 的准确率 [S1.p5]。在性能与计算量的权衡上，ViT 优于 ResNet，达到相同性能约少用 2–4 倍计算量 [S4.SS4.p2]。

evidence.quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
The larger model, ViT-H/14, further improves the performance, especially on the more challenging datasets – ImageNet, CIFAR-100, and the VTAB suite.
the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
First, Vision Transformers dominate ResNets on the performance/compute trade-off.
ViT uses approximately $2-4\times$ less compute to attain the same performance (average over 5 datasets).

limitations.text: 作者指出，ViT 在中小规模数据集上训练时精度低于同规模 ResNet，因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 固有的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置，在数据不足时泛化不佳 [S1.p4]。作者还指出，预训练效率可能不仅受架构选择影响，也受训练计划、优化器、权重衰减等其他参数影响 [S4.SS2.p2]。在自监督方面，作者初步实验显示自监督预训练相比从头训练有提升，但与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S5.p2]。作者也承认，将 ViT 应用于检测和分割等其他视觉任务仍是待解决的挑战 [S5.p2]。

evidence.quote: Transformers lack some of the inductive biases inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality, and therefore do not generalize well when trained on insufficient amounts of data.
However, we note that pre-training efficiency may be affected not only by the architecture choice, but also other parameters, such as training schedule, optimizer, weight decay, etc.
Our initial experiments show improvement from self-supervised pre-training, but there is still large gap between self-supervised and large-scale supervised pre-training.
One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
